summary: Resolved the routines that fill the character-sheet CONTENT (values + dynamic labels) inside the top window *0x546e during creation, and the value source + position + attr + formatting of every content cell. CONTENT IS DRAWN BY THREE COOPERATING wpcmk FUNCTIONS, not one: (1) ui_redraw_character_sheet (wpcmk 0x0df7) draws the dynamic LABELS (LVL/RNK/EXP/MKS) + name + class/rank title + the 6 icon glyphs (chars 0x23-0x28) + the 6 bottom-grid 'cur/max' pairs + (via ui_print_six_attribute_labels 0x0b6d) the 6 bottom-grid number pairs; (2) ui_render_stat_panel (wpcmk 0x2b04) draws the 8 attribute label+value rows (STR..KAR), the BONUS row, and the HP / STM / ENCUMBRANCE 'cur/max' triplet; (3) ui_print_character_header (wpcmk 0x0d52) draws the row-1 header: name + sex glyph + '-' + race name + class name. CALL SITES (in wpcmk_create_character_master 0x4e47): after memset(record 0x5470,432,0)+strcpy(name) it calls ui_print_screen_title, then ui_redraw_character_sheet (file 0x4e72), then ui_render_stat_panel (file 0x4e7b), THEN wpcmk_pick_race_menu (file 0x4e7e). The race picker (0x308d) internally re-runs ui_print_character_header(race name) + ui_render_stat_panel after writing *0x560d=race. A SECOND ui_redraw_character_sheet runs after the portrait picker (master file ~0x4f..). The NAME screen (screen-00, wpcmk_create_via_empty_slot 0x50f2) runs BEFORE the master and only writes the bottom-bar window *0x56ca — it never calls any of these three functions, which is exactly why the top is the bare frame on screen-00 and content appears from screen-01/02 onward. KEY MECHANISM FACTS (all from wroot decompiles): set_cursor(win,x,y) sets col=x,row=y; the cell-write primitives encode the cell ATTR BYTE as (attrParam << 4) — i.e. the attr arg you pass IS the high nibble (background color index) and the low nibble is always 0 (the 'highlight/1bpp render path' the parent observed). Numbers are printed by FUN_0507(win, val_lo, val_hi, fieldWidth, attrParam): it formats the decimal string then RIGHT-ALIGNS it in fieldWidth cells (pads leading spaces, prints trailing fieldWidth chars), advancing the cursor; so values occupy [cursorX .. cursorX+fieldWidth-1] right-justified. Verified against save/1.sav (which is actually the PROFESSION/class-select screen, NOT race-select: it shows real STR=9 INT=8 PIE=8 VIT=9 DEX=9 SPD=8 PER=8 KAR=0 read live from DGROUP 0x559c, BONUS=6 from 0x56ac) and against the all-zero race-select.json fixture.
method: Decompiled wpcmk 0x0df7 (ui_redraw_character_sheet), 0x0b6d (ui_print_six_attribute_labels), 0x2b04 (ui_render_stat_panel), 0x0d52 (ui_print_character_header), 0x308d (wpcmk_pick_race_menu) and the master 0x4e47 via a corrected PyGhidra shim (tools/ghidra/scripts/decompile.py — uses open_project+program_context for pyghidra 3.x; the old dump_function.py's open_program(gpr,'/bin') is broken). Decompiled the wroot UI primitives at their image offsets (Ghidra segmented addr 1000:offset): set_cursor 0x030b, FUN_22b7 single-cell-write 0x22b7, FUN_24e9 write_chars 0x24e9, FUN_05a5 print_signed 0x05a5 -> FUN_0507 number/right-align printer 0x0507. Cross-checked every (col,row,attr,value) against the live save-1 cell dump (tools/parity/dump-cells.py) which renders ASCII art of windows top/bottomBar/menuPanel, and against the all-zero race-select.json fixture. Read DGROUP caches live from save 1 (dgroup_base=0x18048): 0x559c attr array=09 08 08 09 09 08 08 00, 0x56ac bonus=06 00, per-row attr table at wroot DGROUP 0x0004 = words [0,5,4,2,3,6,7,5]. Label msg IDs confirmed via wpcmk-msg-strings.json: 0xc8=LVL 0xc9=RNK 0xca=EXP 0xcb=MKS 0xcc..0xd3=STR/INT/PIE/VIT/DEX/SPD/PER/KAR 0xd4=HP 0xd5=STM.

ui_window_set_cursor.note: win->[6]=x%width, win->[7]=y%height. A few call sites post-increment win->[6] by 1 to leave a 1-cell gap after a label before printing its value.

ui_put_cell_styled.note: Writes ONE cell at cursor = {attr: attrParam<<4, char}, then advances cursor by 1. attrParam is the HIGH NIBBLE of the cell attr; low nibble always 0. This is the ONLY way the attr byte's high nibble (=background color index in the parent's scheme) is set.

ui_window_write_chars.note: Calls putcell for each non-NUL char; same attr=attrParam<<4 rule. Empty string writes nothing (leaves prior cell contents).

ui_print_number.note: Wrapper that sign-extends value to 32-bit then calls FUN_0507(win, lo, hi, fieldWidth, attrParam).

ui_print_curmax_or_number.note: Formats decimal string of the 32-bit value, then prints (fieldWidth - len) leading SPACES (attr=attrParam<<4) and the trailing fieldWidth chars of the string => RIGHT-ALIGNED in fieldWidth cells starting at current cursorX. Advances cursor by fieldWidth. The 'cur/max' pairs are NOT one call: code prints the cur number (width), then a literal '/' via putcell, then the max number (width).

formatting_rules.alignment: Numbers are ALWAYS right-aligned in their fieldWidth via FUN_0507. The cursor is set to the LEFT edge of the field; the printer pads leading spaces so the digits hug the RIGHT edge (cursorX + fieldWidth - 1). A single '0' therefore appears at the right cell of the field, with leading cells blank — exactly what race.json shows.
formatting_rules.no_zero_padding: Pads with SPACES, never '0'. A 2-digit value fills both cells; a 1-digit value blanks the leading cell.
formatting_rules.attr_byte: cellAttr = attrParam << 4. attrParam is the high nibble. Low nibble is always 0 (the highlight/1bpp path). Negative attrParam (e.g. -7 for BONUS label) selects the highlighted/selected style.
formatting_rules.cur_max_pairs: Drawn as THREE writes: print cur (right-aligned width), putcell('/' 0x2f, attr=9 except HP/STM '/' attr=8), set_cursor to the max field's left edge, print max (right-aligned width).
